newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast grants two mineral exploration permits.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast grants two mineral exploration permits.

text.p: Ivory Coast has granted mineral exploration permits for two sites in the centre of the country, a government statement said.
Both were valid for all minerals except hydrocarbons, it said.
Australian-based Equigold secured a permit covering 999 square kilometres in the Oume region. It is expected to invest a minimum of 650 million CFA in the work.
Goldivoire was granted a licence for 812 square kilometres in the Agbaou area near Divo. It is expected to invest at least 659 million CFA.
It was not immediately clear where Goldivoire is based.
The statement did not say how long the permits were valid for but the standard agreement is for three years.
The decision to grant the permits was taken at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
